# Audit Findings and Action Items

This confidential bank document outlines critical action items identified during a recent audit:

*   Urgent update required for AML detection systems.
*   Optimization of AML detection processes is necessary to align with Strategy 2026.
*   Investigation into legal risks stemming from the audit findings is mandated.
*   Further investigation into AML detection for Strategy 2026 is required.
*   Internal controls must be updated on a quarterly basis.
